history.new: The lab's Conjecture 4.6 (CLM-C03-10) on termination of 0^p 1^q -> 1^r 0^s is equivalent to Zantema-Geser Theorem 1.1 (terminating iff p >= s, or q >= r, or p < s < 2p and q does not divide r, or q < r < 2q and p does not divide s); hence it is a published theorem.
history.old: The published complete characterisation of termination of 0^p 1^q -> 1^r 0^s (H. Zantema, A. Geser, AAECC 11 (2000) 1-25; tech. report UU-CS-1994-44) could not be compared with the lab's Conjecture 4.6 (CLM-C03-*), because the full text could not be retrieved from this environment.
